evidence: Major modifications across src/wallet/spend.cpp, src/wallet/feebumper.cpp, src/wallet/coinselection.h, and wallet persistence to enable sending to BIP 352 addresses.
rationale: Enables sending to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses, solving a user privacy pain point by preventing address reuse for recipients. While it provides substantial strategic value for Bitcoin Core's privacy capabilities (part of #28536), it delivers a new feature rather than fixing an urgent fund-safety or security regression.
